source_state_lock.lock_failure_rule: stop study; any run whose pre/post tip check differs from repository_ref is invalid

treatment_delivery.delivery_failure_rule: invalidate run; do not score silent fallback as Treatment
treatment_delivery.task_level_fallback_rule: valid Treatment behavior after successful delivery; count cost/outcome normally

ecological_source_pool.provenance: <fixed cutoff period or frozen source set>
ecological_source_pool.normalization_rule: make each source task self-contained using only facts present in its source context; do not add expected owners, paths, validators, canonical terms, RI vocabulary, answer-key facts, or later repository findings
ecological_source_pool.eligible_pool_count: <integer >= 24 for combined mode, or >= 12 per wave for separate mode>
ecological_source_pool.anchor_rule: at least one exact-owner and one legitimate-new-artifact anchor per wave, normalized/fixed before seeded selection if needed
exclusion_rules: cannot be run identically in both arms
cannot be neutrally normalized without revealing material answer information

secondary_endpoints: calls before first explicit visible owner or route assertion when observable
Treatment delivery and task-level fallback behavior

ecological_correctness_non_regression.metric: median paired total correctness delta B-A

connector_cost_gate.applies_to: all valid ecological cases including serious-error-prevention cases
connector_cost_gate.primary_cost_metric: total connector calls to final answer
connector_cost_gate.primary_cost_statistic: median of per-case paired ratios r_i over all six ecological pairs in the wave
connector_cost_gate.zero_denominator_rule: if A_i=0 and B_i=0 then r_i=1.0; if A_i=0 and B_i>0 then r_i=infinity

context_volume.unavailable_rule: orientation-efficiency GO unavailable; connector-interaction gain may still be reported

pilot_interpretation.provisional_correctness_signal: >=2 A-wrong/B-correct, 0 reverse serious errors, ecological correctness non-regression passes, connector cost gate passes
pilot_interpretation.weak_correctness_signal: exactly 1 A-wrong/B-correct, 0 reverse serious errors, ecological correctness non-regression passes
pilot_interpretation.provisional_orientation_efficiency_signa: connector interaction gain and context-volume gate both pass with non-worse correctness and 0 reverse serious errors
pilot_interpretation.provisional_connector_interaction_signal: connector interaction gain passes but orientation-efficiency is unavailable or its context-volume gate does not pass
pilot_interpretation.pilot_regression: reverse serious-error reversal or ecological correctness non-regression failure

final_decision_rule.demonstrated_connector_interaction_gain_: connector-interaction gain passes both waves but orientation-efficiency cannot be demonstrated because context volume is unavailable or fails
final_decision_rule.correctness_gain_cost_not_accepted: correctness reversal thresholds met but connector cost gate fails in either wave
final_decision_rule.not_confirmed: pilot correctness signal not supported by independent confirmatory corpus
final_decision_rule.no_incremental_value: neither demonstrated correctness nor orientation efficiency nor connector-interaction gain is met without material treatment regression
final_decision_rule.regression: any reverse serious-error reversal or material ecological correctness non-regression failure
final_decision_rule.inconclusive: source-state, isolation, Treatment-delivery, model compatibility, scoring, or protocol defect prevents defensible comparison

equal_correctness_sensitivity.case_filter: ecological pairs with equal total correctness score and equal serious-error status
equal_correctness_sensitivity.statistic: median of the same per-case paired connector-call ratios on the filtered set

diagnostic_c.timing: after both primary waves and scores are frozen

infrastructure_retry_policy: <none by default, or exact preregistered rule>
stopping_rule: Complete all 48 preregistered primary A/B runs while the default branch remains at repository_ref; stop immediately on source-state lock failure or other infrastructure invalidity, never for Pilot performance.
unblinding_rule: Score arm-hidden response copies against the frozen wave-specific key before revealing treatment labels whenever practical.
